title: Landmark Conference Sets Shared Research and Policy Agenda to Address AI's Psychological Harms
summary: Psychologists, researchers and leaders from advocacy, policy, media and philanthropy met at UNC Chapel Hill on October 19–20, agreed seven research priorities and set out a plan for continued collaboration.

title: Psychologists and Civil Society Leaders due to Meet to Urgently Address AI and Mental Health
summary: First of its kind convening marks a watershed moment in AI research, expressing a shared commitment not to repeat the mistakes of social media.
